class LiveHelixConsole(HelixConsole):
    def __init__(self, config, project_root, permissions, mode):
        super().__init__(config, project_root, permissions)
        self.mode = mode
        self.current_role = "main"
        self.current_tool = "idle"
        self.current_state = "READY"
        self.current_step = 0
        self.stall_score = 0
        self.active_file = ""
        self.staged_files = {}
        self.activities = []
        self.reasoning_summary = "Waiting for a task."
        self.current_task = ""
        self.forge_status = "idle"
        self.command_status = "idle"
        self.verification_status = "pending"

    def _activity(self, text):
        self.activities.append(text)
        self.activities = self.activities[-10:]

    @staticmethod
    def _clip(text, width):
        text = str(text).replace("\r", " ").replace("\n", " ")
        return text if len(text) <= width else text[:width - 3] + "..."

    def _render(self):
        if self.mode != "tui":
            return
        sys.stdout.write("\x1b[2J\x1b[H")
        print("+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+")
        print("|                                  H E L I X                                 |")
        print("|                         Autonomous Coding Agent                            |")
        print("+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+")
        print(f"| v{VERSION:<7} | {self.current_role.upper():<8} | {self.current_state:<18} | Step {self.current_step:03d} | Stall {self.stall_score:<3} |")
        print(f"| Project: {self._clip(self.project_root, 66):<66}         |")
        print("+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+")
        print("| ACTIVE WORK                                                                |")
        active = self.active_file or "No active staged file"
        print(f"| {self._clip(active, 74):<74} |")
        for path, chars in list(sorted(self.staged_files.items()))[:4]:
            line = f"  * {path} - {chars} chars"
            print(f"| {self._clip(line, 74):<74} |")
        print("+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+")
        print("| DECISION / STATUS                                                          |")
        print(f"| {self._clip(self.reasoning_summary, 74):<74} |")
        print("+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+")
        print("| PIPELINE                                                                   |")
        pipe = f"MODEL {self.current_role.upper()} | FORGE {self.forge_status} | COMMAND {self.command_status} | VERIFY {self.verification_status}"
        print(f"| {self._clip(pipe, 74):<74} |")
        print("+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+")
        print("| ACTIVITY                                                                   |")
        for item in self.activities[-6:]:
            print(f"| {self._clip(item, 74):<74} |")
        print("+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+")
        print("| CHAT                                                                       |")
        first = next((x.strip() for x in self.current_task.splitlines() if x.strip()), "Ready")
        print(f"| {self._clip(first, 74):<74} |")
        print("| helix>                                                                     |")
        print("+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+")
        sys.stdout.flush()

    def banner(self):
        if self.mode == "trace":
            super().banner()
            print("  Mode      detailed trace")
        else:
            self._render()

    def task_start(self, task):
        self.current_task = task
        self.current_state = "PLANNING"
        self.reasoning_summary = "Analyzing the task and selecting the next action."
        if self.mode == "trace":
            super().task_start(task)
        else:
            self._render()

    def step(self, step, role, tool):
        self.current_step = step
        self.current_role = role
        self.current_tool = tool
        self.current_state = "WORKING"
        self._activity(f"[{step:03d}] {role.upper()} -> {tool}")
        if self.mode == "trace":
            super().step(step, role, tool)
        else:
            self._render()

    def result(self, ok, summary):
        started = re.search(r"Started staged file:\s*(.+?)\s*$", summary)
        if started:
            self.active_file = started.group(1).strip()
            self.staged_files.setdefault(self.active_file, 0)
        staged = re.search(r"Staged\s+\d+\s+(?:raw\s+)?characters for\s+(.+?);\s*(\d+)\s+total", summary)
        if staged:
            self.active_file = staged.group(1).strip()
            self.staged_files[self.active_file] = int(staged.group(2))
        finished = re.search(r"Created via Patch Forge:\s*(.+?);", summary)
        if finished:
            path = finished.group(1).strip()
            self.staged_files.pop(path, None)
            if self.active_file == path:
                self.active_file = ""
        marker = "PASS" if ok else "FAIL"
        first = summary.strip().splitlines()[0] if summary.strip() else ""
        self._activity(f"[{self.current_step:03d}] {marker} {self._clip(first, 50)}")
        if not ok:
            self.current_state = "RECOVERING"
            self.reasoning_summary = "The last action failed; using its diagnostic to recover."
        if self.mode == "trace":
            super().result(ok, summary)
        else:
            self._render()

    def model_error(self, step, message):
        self.current_step = step
        self.current_state = "MODEL ERROR"
        self.reasoning_summary = message
        self._activity(f"[{step:03d}] MODEL ERROR")
        if self.mode == "trace":
            super().model_error(step, message)
        else:
            self._render()

    def stall(self, step, message):
        self.current_step = step
        self.stall_score += 1
        self.current_state = "STALL"
        self.reasoning_summary = message
        self._activity(f"[{step:03d}] STALL")
        if self.mode == "trace":
            super().stall(step, message)
        else:
            self._render()

    def escalation(self, step, role, stall_steps):
        self.current_role = role
        self.current_state = "ESCALATING"
        self.stall_score = stall_steps
        self.reasoning_summary = f"Escalating to {role.upper()} with shared Helix state."
        self._activity(f"[{step:03d}] ROUTER -> {role.upper()}")
        if self.mode == "trace":
            super().escalation(step, role, stall_steps)
        else:
            self._render()

    def model_event(self, kind, data):
        role = str(data.get("role", self.current_role))
        self.current_role = role
        message = str(data.get("message", kind))
        if kind == "raw_start":
            self.current_state = "GENERATING SOURCE"
            self.active_file = str(data.get("path", self.active_file))
        elif kind == "raw_retry":
            self.current_state = "RAW RETRY"
        elif kind == "raw_success":
            self.current_state = "SOURCE READY"
        elif kind in {"raw_failure", "model_failure"}:
            self.current_state = "MODEL ERROR"
        elif kind == "model_repair":
            self.current_state = "MODEL REPAIR"
        self.reasoning_summary = message
        self._activity(f"{role.upper()} {kind}: {self._clip(message, 45)}")
        if self.mode == "trace":
            print(f"  [TRACE] {role.upper():6} {kind.upper():16} {message}")
        else:
            self._render()
        return True

79. append_file_raw is a two-phase operation. Return only the small JSON header during structured action selection.

80. During raw source generation, return literal file content only. Do not wrap it in markdown fences, do not return JSON, and do not include HELIX_CONTENT markers.

81. If Helix reports a raw-generation retry, the append_file_raw action and path are already accepted. Correct only the source body and do not switch tools.

82. Helix may display concise observable decision/status summaries. These are not private chain-of-thought.

def test_parser_accepts_trace_mode(self):
        args = helix.build_parser().parse_args(["--trace"])
        self.assertTrue(args.trace)
        self.assertFalse(args.tui)

    def test_parser_accepts_tui_mode(self):
        args = helix.build_parser().parse_args(["--tui"])
        self.assertTrue(args.tui)
        self.assertFalse(args.trace)

    def test_raw_generation_unwraps_single_markdown_fence(self):
        config = helix.HelixConfig(
            patchforge_cli="",
            max_steps=0,
            command_timeout_seconds=10,
            models={"main": helix.ModelSpec("ollama", "main")},
        )
        router = helix.ModelRouter(config)
        content, unwrapped = router._validate_raw_content("```python\nprint('x')\n```\n")
        self.assertTrue(unwrapped)
        self.assertEqual(content, "print('x')\n")
